newsitem.title: USA: Fonix to restate results for five quarters.
newsitem.headline: Fonix to restate results for five quarters.

text.p: Fonix Corp said Thursday it will restate its financial reports for the last five quarters.
Among items to be recorded, it said, is an additional $2.9 million expense to reflect the issuance to certain employees of warrants at market value on issue date.
It said it had also determined that certain debt forgiven by shareholders should be recorded as a capital contribution rather than as extraordinary items.
Roger Dudley, chief financial officer, said the restatements are being made "simply to better reflect the essense of certain trasnactions."
The restatements will provide additional tax loss carry-forward benefits and will have no effect on total equity, he said.
The restatements follow the hiring of Deloitte & Touche as the company's independent auditors.
Stephen Studdert, Fonix chairman and chief executive, said the auditing firm's expertise will be "invaluable as we move forward in negotiations with potential strategic partners."
Fonix did not say when the restated results would be filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
